g.title: VarkaIRLevels
g.text: Varka IR by data flow: leaves, intermediate nodes, user-visible results

Bottom: the leaves and what fills them. Middle: the operators, grouped by what they produce; each group has one output port (the round node) and the arrows out of it say where that value can go next - including back into its own group (dotted), which is how chains such as year(trunc(date_add(d, n), fmt)) arise. Top: what the user sees. Boxes carry the input components as ports and, in italics, the SQL that compiles to the node. Dashed grey: the emitter's shared fragments, which are code below the IR, not nodes - the civil-from-days prefix that every calendar tail reads, and the mod-7 lowering. Colours: green = date lanes, amber = int field lanes, blue = a stored int column, magenta = an int32 column derived per batch from a string column, grey = literal, violet = condition. Branch varka-task-61, 5 Sep 2026.

g.title: cluster_L2
g.text: level 2: date producers (a date in, a date out)

g.title: cluster_L3
g.text: level 3: field extractors (a date in, an int out)

g.title: cluster_L4
g.text: level 4: conditions and selection (values in, a mask or a chosen value out)

g.title: cluster_frag
g.text: emitter fragments, below the IR (not nodes; shared code inside one lane group)

g.title: L_int
g.text: int column, admitted only as an offset

g.text: filled per batch by the evaluator

g.title: L_tl
g.text: filled per batch by the evaluator

g.title: L_lit
g.text: a folded literal: day offset, month count,

g.title: AddDays
g.text: date_add(d, n), d + INTERVAL n DAY,

g.title: SubDays
g.text: date_sub(d, n), d - INTERVAL n DAY

g.title: AddMonths
g.text: add_months(d, m), d + INTERVAL m MONTH,

g.text: Chrono; the level is part of the shape

g.title: TruncDateDynamic
g.text: trunc(d, fmt) with a string column

g.title: Compare
g.text: op is part of the shape
< <= > >= =, d IN (...) as an Or of =

g.title: IsNotNull
g.text: d IS NOT NULL; IS NULL as Not(IsNotNull)

g.title: U_proj
g.text: SELECT expr: an int32 Arrow column (date or int) plus validity

g.title: Prefix
g.text: emitChronoPrefix: days -> era, rem, century, yearOfCentury, [marchMonth]
one run per distinct date per lane group (task 32 step B; tasks 48, 53, 54);
every Chrono tail and AddMonths read its locals t[0..5]
marchMonth is skipped when no consumer needs it (Year, DayOfYear, trunc YEAR)

g.title: Mod7
g.text: per node, not shared: DayOfWeek, WeekDay, NextDay,

coalesce(a, b) as IfElse(IsNotNull(a), a, b)

g.text: WHERE expr: a Cond root as the selection bitmap (task 21)
